title: Race Against the Guards
mission: Empty the whole vault before the alarm fills
briefing: The guards are coming and the whole vault has to be emptied, not just the top of it. Every extraction is one step: swap the root with the last active chamber, shrink the heap, sift down. There are n of them and each sift walks at most log n floors, which is exactly why Heap Sort costs n log n and why your alarm budget is what it is. No shortcuts, no searching, no second chances.
hints: Every room must leave the active heap, so there are exactly n extractions. Do not waste a step on a wrong click.
The sorted region fills from the right, and it is always in ascending order.
If a wrong swap has left the heap broken, Heapify repairs it for one step - cheaper than fighting it by hand.
